ModMetaData.name: Colony Template
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
Start every colony your way.
- Save your starting crew as a template on the Create Characters page: names, ages, xenotype, backstories, traits, skills and passions, appearance, apparel, weapon, starting possessions and the relations between them. Load it in any new game with one click. - A "setup" button on the bottom bar applies your colony setup: schedule (night owls shifted), work priorities from skills and passions, medicine, self-tend and hostility response. It can also run by itself when a new game starts. - Save the colonists of a running colony as a template too.
Templates are XML files in your save-data folder (ColonyTemplates), readable and editable by hand.
